children: After closing higher for two consecutive days, CME lean hog futures are down 0.8% in early trading. Hog futures are following cutout prices lower, says the Hightower Report in a note, but livestock traders are more eyeing what Thursday's quarterly Hogs and Pigs report from the USDA will have to say about supplies--as well as what Friday's Cold Storage report shows about frozen pork stocks. Live cattle futures are up 0.9% to $2.2135 a pound. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
